text:
elaine: Heads-up: PR #4798 is ready for a style/tone sweep. Hoping to land in today's docs merge window (16:00 PT). Preview: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/pr-4798 (CI running)

nina: taking a look now. first pass: inconsistent wording between 'deployment' and 'endpoint' across the page. we need to pick one per context — prefer 'deployment' for platform concepts and 'endpoint' for the URL/route. @sam can you add a note in the PR?

sam: yep. I'll add a short glossary line and normalize usages. also saw a few passive voice spots in the migration section.

tyler: nit: change "models are served" -> "Redwood serves models" for active voice. also replace "production ready" with our canonical "production-grade".

elaine: good catches. jen, can you confirm the preview build status?

jen: docs-bot posted preview:
```
[docs-bot] Preview for PR #4798: https://preview.builds.redwood.ai/4798
Status: building (6/12 jobs passed)
```

michael: left comments on the SDK snippets. Python example uses a long multi-line request body; recommend a compact, copy-paste-friendly variant.

nina: checklist I'm adding in the PR comment:
- terminology (deployment vs endpoint) 1
- voice (active) 1
- examples (compact SDK snippets) needs update
- broken anchors (found 1) needs update
- preview/CI 1 (build ok so far)

sam: pushed an updated Python snippet:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-alpha", prompt="Summarize this input.")
print(resp.text)
```
short and paste-ready.

nina: re-reviewing examples now. fixed the anchor to the migration guide (#migrate-v1-v2) and adjusted the quickstart wording. looks cleaner.

docs-bot: 
```
[CI] All checks passed for PR #4798 1:00:12 UTC
[Deploy] Preview available: https://preview.builds.redwood.ai/4798
```

tyler: LGTM from product POV. tiny style nit: prefer explicit "Redwood" instead of "we" in public docs.

elaine: we have two +1s (tyler, sam). nina, can you sign off after the final snippet check?

nina: done. snippets updated, anchor fixed, voice edits applied. approving now.

sam: approving too. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks — merging during the 16:00 PT window.

docs-bot: 
```
[Merge] PR #4798 merged by elaine at 16:07 PT
[Publish] Docs site publishing started.
```

michael: will smoke-test the published page and report any regressions.

docs-bot: 
```
[Publish] Complete: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/migrate
```

elaine: great work. follow-up: i'll open a short ADR to lock the 'deployment vs endpoint' guidance so reviewers have a reference. jen, can you add a note in the docs handbook about merge window expectations?

jen: will do. closing thread. :tada:
